---
title: "Posters & Presentations"
---

Conference posters and presentations from the EEGManySteps initiative. Full-resolution versions are available via the linked Google Drive folders.

::: {.callout-note}
Poster images will be added here as they become available. If you presented an EEGManySteps poster, please share the image and Drive link via a [pull request](https://github.com/EEGManySteps/eegmanysteps.github.io/pulls) or email [eegmanysteps@gmail.com](mailto:eegmanysteps@gmail.com).
:::
